# Privacy Checklist: macOS Live Route Readiness

**Purpose**: Validate privacy, diagnostics, secret, and data-boundary requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are no-hidden-recording requirements explicitly applied to readiness checks and active non-recording route state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/FR-017]
- [x] CHK002 Are diagnostics requirements explicit about excluding raw audio, transcript text, credentials, tokens, and signed URLs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 Are external egress boundaries explicit: no MediaScribe, Langfuse, analytics, or new network egress? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is the difference between readiness evidence metadata and raw audio artifact storage clear? [Clarity, Constitutional Requirements]
- [x] CHK005 Are temporary development stimulus/debug artifacts constrained as explicit, local, release-disabled, and cleanable? [Clarity, Constitutional Requirements]
- [x] CHK006 Are audit events required without allowing raw audio or transcript payloads? [Clarity, Constitutional Requirements]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK007 Can diagnostics redaction success be objectively verified from the stated requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are privacy requirements traceable to both functional requirements and constitutional requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-015/FR-018]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are failure cases involving app exit, driver restart, browser target change, and route degradation covered without requiring raw audio diagnostics? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are blocked/not accepted browser records constrained to metadata-only evidence? [Spec §FR-016]

## Notes

- These items test requirement quality, not implementation behavior.
